chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Ch. 337: Daofather Crimsonbright's Offer Changes the Game
chapter_meta_description: When Daofather Crimsonbright announces he'll take a disciple from the top three, the Immortal Fortunes Assembly erupts. Ji Ning reveals his monstrous power against the Red Lotus Sect.
og_title: Ji Ning's Dominance Shines in the Arena!
og_description: The survival stakes just got higher. A Daofather's patronage is on the line, and Ji Ning is all in.
twitter_title: Desolate Era Ch. 337: Ji Ning shows who the real monster is.
twitter_description: The Immortal Fortunes Assembly heats up as a Daofather's recruitment changes everything. Ji Ning steps up.

lore_anchors.definition: A supreme being of the Three Realms who grasped the Heavenly Dao and created the legendary Crimsonbright Diagram of the Nine Heavens. He is a former Chaos True God with a deep friendship with Daoist Threelives.
The pinnacle of Fiendgod Body Refining, representing an ancient entity born from the primordial chaos, whose physical body is nigh-indestructible and whose status rivals that of a Daofather.
The highest level of ordinary Celestial Immortal, a stage below a Daofather, representing perfection of the Yang aspect of one's immortal energy.
A classic divine ability in Xianxia that allows a cultivator to grow extra limbs, drastically increasing their offensive and defensive capabilities in combat.
The highest grade of standard magical treasure in the Grand Xia, vastly superior to mortal and Earth-ranked treasures, capable of unleashing devastating power.
